headline: Converge ICT Solutions 9-Month Earnings Slip 9% on Higher Expenses
summary: Converge ICT Solutions Inc. reported an 9% decline in net earnings to 8.09 billion pesos for the first nine months, as higher operating expenses outpaced slower revenue growth.
why: Telecommunications providers face margin pressures when operating and network expansion costs grow faster than subscriber revenues.

impacts.name: Converge ICT Solutions Inc.
impacts.why: Higher operating expenses and slower revenue growth reduce net income for broadband providers.
